title: An issue has been discovered in ClickHouse Server that, under certain conditions, could allow an unauthenticated user…
description: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-116366) has been identified in ClickHouse Server that could allow an unauthenticated user with network access to execute arbitrary code under certain conditions. The vulnerability has a high CVSS 4.0 score of 9.5, indicating severe impact. No affected versions or patch information are provided, and there are no known exploits in the wild at this time.
